manifest_binding.meaning: Hash computed from the manifest.json bytes currently present in the reviewed v3 input directory. All reported row counts and file hashes below were checked against that same directory during this review.

review_scope.content: Read every turn in each of the 24 teacher dialogues and checked role boundaries, Chinese expression, facts and logic, leakage of existing development questions or internal project details, unsupported identity or firsthand-experience claims, and value statements.
review_scope.integrity: Read manifest.json; computed SHA-256 for the manifest and all four JSONL files; counted and parsed every JSONL row; checked teacher and foundations row counts against token-row counts. The 65 foundations dialogues were integrity-checked and inventoried, while the requested line-by-line content review covers the 24 teacher dialogues.
review_scope.limits: Read-only review only. No training, checkpoint evaluation, or input-file modification was performed.

pilot_decision.reason: The 24 reviewed dialogues are coherent, low-stakes examples of multi-turn reference, correction, clarification, instruction following, simple reasoning, and interpersonal values. The v2 wording concern in row 2 is corrected to the natural phrase '喜欢晒太阳'. One minor ambiguity remains in row 15 about whether a broken empty box counts as a remaining box. It does not materially compromise the set for a short controlled pilot.
conditions: Keep the experiment short and use a predeclared step or token budget with the parent checkpoint retained for rollback.
Compare against fixed multi-turn cases before and after training, scoring semantic correctness, correction handling, repetition, and role boundaries rather than relying on loss alone.
Stop if semantic performance regresses, repetition increases, or corrected context remains unreliable.
Approval covers only this bounded experiment; it does not certify general chat ability or authorize an unrestricted training run.

overall_assessment.summary: No material blocker found. Dialogue-local memory wording remains bounded to facts provided in the conversation. Row 18 explicitly rejects a personal cycling biography. Value statements favor honesty, responsibility, fairness, consent, and respectful communication without coercion or harmful framing.
